kycBankJourney.title: Change your bank account
kycBankJourney.description: Add a new bank account for claim settlements.
kycBankJourney.stepUpSummary: Change your bank account to the account ending {{last4}}. It is checked by a penny-drop (mock) and then approved by your employer.

step1.heading: Your bank
step1.ifscHint: 11 characters, e.g. SBIN0001234 — on your cheque book or passbook

step2.heading: Account number
step2.accountHint: 9 to 18 digits, as on your passbook

step3.heading: Check your answers
step3.note: We check the account with a ₹1 penny-drop (mock), then your present employer approves it. Claims are paid to it once approved.

confirmation.title: Bank account checked
confirmation.body: Verified by {{verifier}}. Your employer approves it next; you will get a message. Until then claims are paid to the account now on record.

errors.ifscFormat: Enter the IFSC as 4 letters, a zero, then 6 letters or numbers
errors.accountDigits: Account number must be between 9 and 18 digits
errors.accountMismatch: The account numbers do not match
errors.verificationFailed: The bank could not confirm this account: {{reason}}
